milestone: Phase 10 - Milestone 2 of 3 - OH/KY collection expansion

seeding.note: Every eligible profile with a permitting_url and no frontier was attempted in both states. Failures remain explicit review gaps; none were marked successful.

drain.route: continueDiscoveryBacklog via deployed shared module; production fetcher contract (safeExternalFetch + readPermittingResourceResponse, 12s timeout); one page per cycle, breadth-first oldest-updated
drain.note: Each fetched page also harvests new same-host links. Continuation runs 8-12 (Oct 23) ran at 0 errors - entity-read limits no longer triggered after frontend read-throttling shipped. OH pending is now net-declining.

rate_limit_handling: Serialized all seed/drain work after parallel runs triggered repeated 429 'entity read traffic volume' limits; paced calls and retry-tolerant batches; partially truncated batches left profiles eligible (never falsely marked complete).
protected_data: No manual/pinned/archive-protected record was modified; all writes used guarded same-version persistence; no client/job/shared records touched; no authority or applicability conclusions drawn.
ongoing: Scheduled permittingResearchBacklogDispatch continues draining frontiers at 5 profiles per 15-minute cycle, Ohio-first. Residual pending_pages backlog (~3,367) is an active, bounded discovery frontier, not an unattempted gap. Failed-seed jurisdictions (163 total) require corrected permitting_url sources before discovery can proceed.

page_fetch_failed.nature: mostly cross-host portals (MyAccount, iworq, third-party hosts) correctly out of same-host scope, plus JS-gated same-host pages; largely structural, not retryable by static discovery

depth_frontier.nature: pages beyond max_depth - intentional depth bound, not failures
